150053568350107_1507206884762927 feeds_service September 18, 2026 At the Saskatchewan Nuclear Energy Forum in Toronto this week, Cameco CEO Tim Gitzel joined Scott Moe and former Prime Minister Stephen Harper for a fireside chat on leading global nuclear industry development. The forum highlighted Saskatchewan's strengths across the nuclear value chain, from world-class uranium resources to innovation and supply chain development. We're thrilled to be part of the growing momentum behind nuclear energy and the discussions shaping its future.
